description: Finds the video clip of a movie or TV scene and turns it into one clean reference take for an AI remake, a parody, an edit or a motion-control run. Covers which clip database fits a quote, a film and scene, a look or a character; which of them an agent may fetch and which only a person opens; a tested yt-dlp search and download; cutting straight from a public-domain film on the Internet Archive; a script that splits a scene into uncut takes with a contact sheet; the rules for a take a video model can follow; and a rights check. Use when someone asks where to find movie clips, film scene references, a scene by its quote, scene packs, a reference video for Seedance, Kling Motion Control, MiniMax Recast or Higgsfield Genjutsu, or says the source has cuts, watermarks or black bars. For still frames use find-references; for the remake itself use scene-recast-video.
